I am an assistant professor of economics at Dartmouth College. My research interests are in public and labor economics, with a focus on inequality and the criminal justice system. You can view my CV [here](cv.qmd) and can contact me at [steve.mello@dartmouth.edu](mailto:steve.mello@dartmouth.edu).
